briefs.k-mechanic:
alphavar specifics:

- Absolute imports only (D1); run project commands via `uv run <cmd>` (e.g. `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check src tests tools`).
briefs.k-validator:
alphavar specifics:

- Gates: `uv run pytest` (targeted first), `uv run ruff check src tests tools`, keystone's `python3 _forge/keystone/bin/verify.py --strict` / `bin/sync.py --check`, and the keystone test suite when named.
- Math / DataFrame-shape / architecture territory is D2 (owner verifies) — stop and report, never "fix" it.
briefs.k-implementer:
alphavar specifics:

- Load-bearing abstractions: the provider pattern (`AbstractProvider`), the column dictionary (`options/dictionary/`), pandera schemas (`options/schemas/`), and `lib/` purity — DataFrame in → DataFrame out, no I/O in `lib/` (R#: docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE_REQUIREMENTS.md).
- Commands via `uv run <cmd>`; absolute imports (D1); D2/D5 are always-on (owner verifies math/data-shape; owner owns commits).
briefs.k-reasoner:
alphavar specifics:

- Numerics are pure-numpy — the project uses no scipy; hand-rolled optimizers/solvers live in the pricer domain.
- Math / DataFrame-shape / architecture conclusions are D2 drafts — flag every formula and shape change for owner verification.
